title: Datacenter Clean-Agent Fire Suppression System Inspection Record
description: Evidence model for inspection and function-test of clean-agent (FM-200 / Novec 1230 / Inergen / CO2) fire suppression systems protecting IT-equipment rooms. These systems use inert or halocarbon gases instead of water to avoid damaging electronic equipment, but the discharged gas itself poses an asphyxiation hazard to workers during testing, maintenance, or accidental discharge. Records agent cylinder integrity, room integrity (hold) test, occupant warning/evacuation interlocks, and discharge-test scheduling.

protected_room_id.description: Identifier of the IT/server room or whitespace protected by the system

agent_type.description: Clean agent medium; CO2 flagged for acute asphyxiation hazard at design concentration

agent_cylinder_weight_kg.description: Measured cylinder agent mass; compared against nominal to detect leakage

design_concentration_pct.description: Design volumetric concentration of agent in protected room at discharge (volume %)

room_integrity_test_passed.description: Door-fan / integrity test result confirming the room enclosure can hold the design concentration for the required hold time (typically >=10 min)

occupant_warning_interlock_tested.description: Pre-discharge alarm, time delay, and audible/visual evacuation signals verified functional

discharge_test_due_date.description: Next scheduled full-discharge or inspector-witness functional test date
